findings.summary: altctl/internal/config has no direct package unit tests pinning C-02 !errors.As negation
findings.rationale: altctl/internal/config/config.go:106 correctly preserves !errors.As(err, &configFileNotFoundError), but go test reports [no test files] for internal/config; direct unit tests for missing vs malformed .altctl.yaml would harden C-02 coverage independent of cmd tests.

findings.summary: echo.StatusCode(err) returning 0 for plain errors in DOSProtectionMiddleware matches pre-v5 semantics
findings.rationale: In alt-backend/app/middleware/dos_protection_middleware.go:169, echo.StatusCode(err) returns 0 when err does not implement HTTPStatusCoder, matching Echo v4 err.(*echo.HTTPError) while improving wrapped HTTPError 5xx detection.

findings.summary: Unguarded GetDeletedAt().AsTime() and GetCreatedAt().AsTime() in search-indexer coerce nil timestamps to 1970-01-01
findings.rationale: Unlike pre-processor/app/repository/backend_api_article.go:191 which checks a.GetCreatedAt() != nil, search-indexer/app/driver/backend_api/client.go:173 and :248 call .AsTime() directly on proto getter results, turning a missing timestamp into non-zero Unix epoch 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

findings.summary: auth-hub getEnv silently falls back when <KEY>_FILE fails readConfigFile and a non-empty fallback or env var exists
findings.rationale: auth-hub/config/config.go:316 ignores readConfigFile errors when err != nil; required secrets (CSRF_SECRET_FILE, INTERNAL_AUTH_SECRET_FILE) still fail Validate() when raw env vars are unset, but setting KRATOS_URL_FILE to a missing/escaping path silently boots with default http://kratos:4433 instead of failing fast under CLAUDE.md Rule 9.

findings.summary: altctl resolveUnderBase allows symlink escape out of backupDir during Manifest.Verify and Migrator.Restore
findings.rationale: altctl/internal/migrate/manifest.go:128 validates lexical filepath.Join/filepath.Rel only without os.OpenRoot(backupDir) or EvalSymlinks, contradicting the #nosec G304 containment comments at manifest.go:184 and postgres.go:166; a symlink inside backupDir (e.g. volumes/db.dump -> outside file) passes Verify and streams outside host files into Restore.

findings.summary: altctl CreateEnvFile follows .env symlinks outside projectRoot and skips Chmod(0o600) on force overwrite
findings.rationale: altctl/internal/setup/envfile.go:36 uses os.Stat + os.WriteFile instead of os.OpenRoot(projectRoot) + Chmod: a dangling .env symlink bypasses os.Stat (force=false) and writes arbitrary files outside projectRoot, a live .env symlink overwrites outside targets on force=true, and overwriting a pre-existing 0o644 .env leaves its mode at 0o644 instead of 0o600.

findings.summary: Dead nilerr fallback in html_parser.extractPTagsFromReader and missing unit test file in stream_article_tags_usecase
findings.rationale: alt-backend/app/utils/html_parser/parser.go:49 suppresses nilerr with 'malformed HTML falls back to plain-text extraction', but bluemonday.SanitizeReader buffers in memory and golang.org/x/net/html.Parse never errors on malformed markup; separately, alt-backend/app/orchestrator/usecase/stream_article_tags_usecase/usecase.go:58 has [no test files] in its own package.

findings.summary: OllamaGateway.chat_stream omits async with aclosing(...), releasing RT semaphore slot while upstream Ollama stream stays open
findings.rationale: Unlike OllamaGateway._build_streaming_generator (ollama_gateway.py:442) which wraps generate_stream in async with aclosing(...), chat_stream (ollama_gateway.py:989) iterates self.stream_driver.chat_stream(payload) bare; when a client disconnects mid-stream and stream_ndjson calls aclose(), _stream catches GeneratorExit and releases the HIGH PRIORITY semaphore slot in finally while stream_driver.chat_stream remains unclosed (driver_closed=False).

repro.command:
cd news-creator/app && uv run --offline python -c 'import asyncio, contextlib, unittest.mock as um; from news_creator.gateway.ollama_gateway import OllamaGateway; cfg=um.MagicMock(ollama_request_concurrency=2,scheduling_rt_reserved_slots=1,scheduling_aging_threshold_seconds=60.0,scheduling_aging_boost=0.5,scheduling_preemption_enabled=False,scheduling_preemption_wait_threshold_seconds=2.0,scheduling_priority_promotion_threshold_seconds=600.0,scheduling_guaranteed_be_ratio=5,max_queue_depth=10,scheduling_rt_mode="fifo",scheduling_aging_sweep_interval_releases=8,oom_detection_enabled=False); gw=OllamaGateway(cfg); closed=False
async def fake_stream(_):
    global closed
    try:
        yield {"message":{"content":"a"},"done":False}
        yield {"message":{"content":"b"},"done":True}
    finally:
        closed=True
gw.stream_driver.chat_stream=fake_stream
async def run():
    gen=await gw.chat_stream({"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]})
    async with contextlib.aclosing(gen) as s:
        async for _ in s: break
    assert closed, "upstream chat_stream still open after aclose() and slot release"
asyncio.run(run())'
